storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Like the most precocious of children, she is always attuned to your innermost thoughts, forever drawing out your trust and confessions, then, at just the right moment, offering you the "blessing" you've longed for. 
But bear this in mind: never let her dainty frame and pitiful eyes stir compassion within you, lest you become one more of the many greedy souls that pure white form has devoured.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
This Silver Core was recovered by Mythag's Keeper %player% in the aftermath of the Mount Ever@2t collapse incident. As the dimension in which it originally resided is no longer observable, the consequences of Silver Core extraction—as well as the proper awakening method—remain undetermined.

The following observations are transcribed from the paper handbook carried by Keeper %player%:

Upon visual inspection, the Silver Core presents as exceptionally pure, showing no discernible impurities. In the absence of external interference, its overall structure trends toward regularity—as though some underlying will were straining to keep it appearing whole and composed, radiating a bright luster not unlike firelight.

Its Gnosis Index, however, sits near the absolute lower bound. The actual internal structure is extraordinarily fragile and loosely bound. When the observation distance falls below 1/@1 inch, the Silver Core's self-protection response is triggered: the observer is abruptly confronted with a dense flow of particles resembling drifting ice crystals. It is presumed these particles were previously refracting incident light in a highly unusual manner, shielding the interior from direct observation.
To put it less professionally... I'd call this a Silver Core steeped in "deception."

Once the self-protection mechanism is triggered, the observer's body enters a brief paralytic state, the pupils gradually fading until fully blanched. Throughout this window, the Silver Core continues to adjust itself, returning to the stable configuration it maintained prior to observation.
Repeated trials indicate that the mechanism inflicts no lasting harm; however, the accompanying hypothermic symptoms pose a non-negligible risk. Note: prompt consumption of sweets—apple-based desserts in particular—provides a distinctly soothing effect. The reason for this... remains unclear... <Italic:Right?
>


Luckily, after everything, it's plain enough that this selfish, tightly-guarded little trickster bears no genuine ill will toward us.

—Excerpt from <Italic:Mythag University Silver Core Storage Records>

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
As everyone knows, what do they call a school?

An ivory tower!

It sounds a perfect match for the title of "Fairy"—after all, where else could one find such a flawless paradise, filled with wealthy, leisurely people whose hearts brim with precious, naive trust, all just waiting to become devoted followers?

Caraboo's cult grew at a truly astonishing pace, amassing a considerable number of followers in a very short time. The core faithful were almost entirely young Awakeners, who believed in this "Fairy Godmother" with near-devout fervor, willingly turning over fixed offerings of candy and sweets at regular intervals. Surprisingly, or perhaps not, Caraboo did indeed bestow blessings from time to time, most often during the traditional holidays of the Kingdom of Leonia, such as the impossible snowfall that came during the Silverfrost Eve of 3@1, and the candy rain on New Year's Eve that people still speak of to this day.

The Academic Affairs Office, it seems, never once discussed whether to put a stop to this "on-campus proselytizing" that, in principle, ought not to exist in the first place.

"Let them play. We all know what these children have been through. There are certain things only another child can do."

"Of course, don't let it go too far."

A certain school staff member, who prefers to remain unnamed, offered the above remarks with a warm smile. According to unreliable sources, the incident preceding her afternoon tea with Caraboo was the one and only time Caraboo has ever truly attempted to cross the school's rules.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
Caraboo was still a child when the Crusades were at their height. Alone and with no one to turn to, she resolved to travel east to the Principality of Antioch to seek out her aunt's family. Word had it that the new lands of the East stood for freedom and dreams, that even someone without a penny to their name could carve out a way there. Her Aunt Rosa had even started up a farm and was doing quite well for herself. Caraboo had been close with Aunt Rosa in her early childhood, and she made up her mind to save enough for the fare to Antioch.

Caraboo drifted through the city's slums, a girl with no connections, scraping by on stealing, swindling, cheating, and conning; whatever innocence she once had was worn away completely. In time, she crossed paths with a wizard named Evagh, who made her a promise: work with him, and they'd split the offerings of his followers thirty-seventy—enough for her to save her travel fare east, and plenty left over to buy heaps of her beloved candy. And so the two formed a con artist duo, with Caraboo enshrined as a little fairy godmother in a makeshift rural temple, while Evagh gathered followers in her name as her high priest.

As Caraboo's fame in the region grew, she found herself no longer content with the current split, and threatened to walk out on the partnership, forcing Evagh to flip the arrangement into a seventy-thirty split in her favor. Now finally with the upper hand, Caraboo lived at her leisure as a false godmother, until she discovered that Evagh had been embezzling her offerings all along, secretly taking three wives and fathering four sons behind her back. Faced with this betrayal, Caraboo showed no anger. She told Evagh, in the tenderest of tones, that she had long known heading east was nothing but an empty, distant dream, that money was of no use to her, and it would be better left in his hands; her only wish was to share a meal with Evagh's family, and together discuss their future ventures in fraud.

Delighted to find that Caraboo had finally come to her senses, Evagh happily extended the invitation for her to attend the banquet. As dinner drew near its end, Caraboo's expression suddenly changed, and at a single word from her, the nearby villagers—her loyal believers—came storming in, wielding farming tools and kitchenware, beating the wizard's household of eight half to death, while everything of value in the house was swept clean away. "You're still too green to fool me"—Caraboo departed in satisfaction, not yet noticing the small black triangle upon her own forehead...

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
Have you ever tried telling a lie? The first lie to leave your lips always comes with a stumbling tongue, a heart that nearly leaps out of your throat, and sweat gathering in your palms; even the gentle sunlight becomes a dizzying, blinding glare.

But once a lie has been repeated ten thousand times, the fear fades away. The words spoken grow smooth, the mind grows ever clearer, and the smile settles into something quite natural.

Playing the fairy, playing the godmother, playing the kin of some figure in power—she had long since mastered the myriad layered identities she had fabricated, grown accustomed to hiding herself behind her lies, until she herself became but a part of the lies.

And that first little hare still hides within a small farm bathed in the sunset light of her memories.

On nights when the ice thaws and the snow melts away, it quietly peeks its head out once more.

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: So nice to meet you! I'm a Pale Fairy from faraway lands. Care to hear more? A fairy's blessing comes in different strengths, depending on your membership tier, hehe~

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: Well now, aren't you a devout little lamb.

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: A little more, and then the Fairy will bless you, hmm?

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: Mmm, delicious~♪

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: At past worship ceremonies, besides the sevenfold rite and the threefold vow, the faithful would build me a brand-new temple and present lavish tribute. Here's the list!

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: Everything on the list... gathered already? Mythag's fortune runs deeper than I can fathom... If I'd known, I would've... Hmm? What am I muttering about, you ask? Just thanking Lord Dexter for his generosity, hehe~

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: This worship ceremony will be grander than any before—and the offerings will need to be greater in number too... Oh my, we're not chopping their limbs off, of course! I'm a kind-hearted fairy; I'd never do anything to hurt anyone~

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: Wowww, this much tribute...! Ahem. Hehe, well done, you've earned a reward! Come here, I'll grants you a fairy's kiss! ...What are you thinking? On the forehead, obviously!

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: Thank you all for your offerings, faithful ones! Your ever-understanding Godmother will have a solid-gold statue of you raised in the temple, too. Oh my—to capture that cold, elegant figure of yours, I'll simply have to go gathering a good deal more~

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: Come, stand here beside your Fairy. What? Everyone shares the offerings and eats together? ...Well. If that's Mythag's custom... then I... I certainly have no objection at all. Come now, everyone, let's make it a party!

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: I hear you've been asking about where I come from. Hehe, now that's a Godmother's little secret. Buuut, if you simply must go digging, the Holy Order does keep a biography I penned myself. Yours to read for a mere hundred thousand Silvers. Care to give it a try?

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: Still haven't given up? Fine, fine—Caraboo will tell you herself. You see, Caraboo is the daughter of Umapati, goddess of a certain cloud-piercing snow-peak in the East... Hmm? That goddess had two sons and no daughter? Well, records of the divine are always a little... incomplete, you see.

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: You don't believe me? Boo-hoo... I suppose you really can't pull the wool over everyone's eyes... The truth is, I'm the bastard daughter of Bohemond VI of @1, living in hiding among mortals, and I only ever claimed to be a fairy to escape the enemy's hunt... I've told you my most precious secret now. You wouldn't not believe me... would you?

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: All right, all right, stop digging, would you? Be a good {Male=boy,Female=girl} and drop this rude little investigation, and I'll secretly share half my most precious candy with you. You know, out on the Crusade battlefields, sweet candy was a rare treasure indeed.

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content:
Keeper, are you ready for Caraboo's truest confession, from the bottom of her heart?
Where I come from doesn't matter at all. What really matters is this: You are a gift to me from heaven, and I've decided to stay by my precious benefactor's side, forever and ever. 
Is this another lie to stop you from further digging up my dirt, you ask? Hehe, what do you think?
Anyway... I think I deserve a little treat for sharing my true feelings with you. An apple flavored gummy would do, please?

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: Hmm? Curious, are we? A Godmother's treasure vault isn't for outsiders' eyes, you know. If you're just dying to know what's stuffed so full inside... why not join the Holy Order right now... Hehe.

daily.title: Chat: About the Crisis
daily.content: Caraboo's blessing can cure every illness in the world—including this black plague, of course... Of course it's true! You just have to be devout enough, trust Caraboo enough, hehe.

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: Oh, it's lovely here—so many adorable children, and welfare subsidies generous to the point of obscene. With all this, I'll have saved up my travel fare to the East soon enough...

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: Too much candy? No no no, this is a Godmother's secret to keeping her smile, you know. As if I'd stop over a little thing like a cavity?

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: What do I hate most? Wizards with no respect for a contract, obviously. Here's a little secret, just between us: every last wizard is a big fat fraud. All their so-called prophecies and curses? Just tricks to swindle you into the poorhouse! And how do you protect yourself...? Simple! Just let all your money receive the Fairy's blessing!

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: You? ...You're one of our flock, not yet enlightened. Caraboo will wait, patiently, for the day you see the world's true nature. And when that day comes—remember to offer up your body, your loyalty, and your worldly goods to everyone's Godmother. Hehe.

daily.title: Chat: About Ogier
daily.content: Huh, how did Ogier let you in? He promised he'd keep everyone out. You're his liege...? Ugh, unreliable little children are such a headache. I put a lot of work into preparing this gathering, you know. Say... fifty-fifty on the offerings we take in, and you look the other way for me?

daily.title: Chat: About Ryker
daily.content: So sorry, but the Fairy's domain is sacred ground—we don't receive strange werewolves here... Something about the air smelling of lies? His nose must just be on the fritz.

daily.title: Chat: About the Rumors
daily.content: Huh? Someone's saying I'm a fake fairy... Well, I'm caught. hehe. But I know you won't mind... right?

battle.title: Investigation Begins
battle.content: Ta-daa~ the Fairy's radiance shines upon you now. Go get 'em!

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: Little lambs gone astray, your Fairy's here to wash your sins away, hehe~

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: It's fine! Next time, just focus on protecting your Fairy, and you won't fail~

battle.title: Defense: I
battle.content: Don't even try to fool me!

battle.title: Skill: II
battle.content: You're all still a little green~

battle.title: Rouse
battle.content: Don't forget to worship your Godmother, hehe.

battle.title: Exalt
battle.content: Come now... bury everything you wish to cast off deep in the snow...

battle.title: Over-Exaltation
battle.content: The sevenfold rite, the threefold vow—offer them up, and buy yourself the Fairy's absolution!
